name: financial-journalism-style
description: Guides style-editor (and reporter during drafting) through house-style conventions for Korean business/finance journalism, drawing on general conventions associated with Sedaily (general economic-daily tone) and TheBell (IB/PE/capital-markets specialist tone). Default output language is Korean; non-Korean assignments use general business-journalism conventions instead. Use when: Phase 4, by style-editor on the reporter's draft; also referenced by reporter during Phase 3 drafting.
